scope: iOS 1.2026.293 History sidebar bottom-action parent; bounded follow-up. Evidence only; no runtime, product edits or account data access.

candidate_groups.scope: Existing container/projection and view-model publisher getters
Action-components configuration and profile item body
Callback wrappers/value helpers and controller constraint receiver check

method.stop_reason: Three bounded candidate groups reached. No verified avatar-versus-cog selector or complete footer geometry recovered; do not broaden task to force an implementation.

observations.conclusion: The footer profile content enum has avatar(payload) and settingsCog cases. Its content input is separate from account-switcher capability, presentation binding, settings action, and account-switcher action. The account-switcher capability is insufficient to choose the visible avatar/cog case.
limits: Enum inventory proves supported content branches, not the default or current account-visible case. Actual enum construction/assignment upstream remains unclosed.

observations.conclusion: The original settings action container passes its stored metric inputs and separate action/binding inputs to its child. A replacement should preserve these inputs instead of deriving all state from one boolean.

evidence_points.detail: Container field-offset loads copy two metric value/optional-tag pairs. Metadata names the fields avatarSize and minimumHitTargetSize; this window does not establish their caller-supplied numeric values.
presentsAccountSwitcherPopover field participates in selecting the presentation binding versus constant false.
settingsAction callback reference 0x1373988 is supplied separately.
Capability boolean and accountSwitcherAction callback reference 0x13739c4 are separate child inputs.
Callback obtains VM/context and sends action numeric tag 4 through 0x700ae4; the action enum tag is not independently named in this follow-up.
Separate callback forwards into 0x1282d28 with w1=1.

limits: Numeric avatar size, hit-target size and account/content capability mapping are not resolved.

observations.conclusion: 0x13559fc referenced by the container is a type metadata accessor, and 0x1373934 is the HistoryProfileButtonContent metadata accessor. Neither proves an avatar/cog branch decision.

evidence_points.detail: Reference to 0x13559fc appears in bound/generic container setup.
Metadata accessor uses descriptor 0x9593e84 and runtime metadata cache 0xb17ad48.

observations.conclusion: HistoryViewController owns a distinct bottom action background and distinct stored constraints for the new-chat button bottom, leading and inter-item spacing. Footer geometry must be traced independently of the header and independent child button chrome.
limits: Storage addresses identify metadata/global ivar-offset slots, not runtime object byte offsets. HistoryBottomActionItemsBackgroundView has a _reduceTransparency field in metadata; this alone does not prove material/color or a specific blur implementation.

observations.conclusion: The source footer inset getter is dynamic: compact vertical size class uses max(safeArea.bottom,16); another branch reads scene corner configuration with literal bounds24/40; legacy/no-scene chooses24 for zero bottom safe area otherwise38, and no-window fallback38.
limits: Full scene-corner field mapping/formula remains partial. This is reused existing evidence, not a new universal bottom margin. Do not set16/24/38/40 globally.

excluded_probes.actual_scope: Header, despite filename: 0x129708c..0x1297090 loads navigationHeaderLayoutGuide via slot0xadb9618; following top/leading/trailing/height constraints belong to that receiver.
excluded_probes.do_not_claim: The -6 top offset and56 height in this probe are not bottom footer geometry and provide no footer patch value.

safe_now: Preserve the already recovered new-chat component chrome/label as a distinct child.
Keep explicit profile-content input separate from canShowAccountSwitcher and presentation state in the host contract.
If preview needs both avatar and cog for inspection, choose them only through an explicitly synthetic capability fixture, not a claimed293 account-default rule.
not_supported_now: Replacing fixed gear with avatar automatically based on canShowAccountSwitcher or screenshots.
Applying header height56/top-6 to bottom controls.
A global fixed bottom margin or arbitrary new footer material.
